reply_text:
㊥ (the table) I've written the table, using `wm-click-acts.edn` as the authority (futon2 `450387929`). Nine of the 23 marks have a WM click act. Five of those nine are at the same stage on both sides: propose, prioritize, redirect, continue and verify. Where the two sources disagree, the menu puts a mark where a reader takes it in, and the WM puts it where the speaker does it. So report, report-problem and delegate are ACT in the WM. The other fourteen marks have no click act, and EVALUATE is empty on both sides.

㊢ (what's in the commit) `holes/labs/wm-contract/mark_act_alignment.bb` generates the table. It reads `wm-click-acts.edn`, the `xiaoxiang-mark-keys` list from the C-c ; menu and `control-stages.edn`, and edits none of them. `mark-act-alignment.md` holds its output with my reading of it. Rerun the script whenever any of the three sources changes. It also lists the four acts with no intent, the nodes no act is tagged with, and any act whose stage disagrees with the node registry. clj-kondo reports 0 errors. `check-parens.el` skipped the file because of its `.bb` extension, so no paren check ran.

🈹 (my last turn) Two of last turn's claims don't hold against the table:
- I said dispatch-author fits 🈸 ask-action. The file tags it `:delegate`.
- I paired ㊢ with R2 and ㊩ with R8. Those were reader-side guesses. The file puts both at ACT: publish-selection-trace on TRACE, and queue-failure-brief on R16.

㊩ (a defect in the acts file) `request-interpretation` is tagged `:PERCEIVE :R7`. The node registry puts R7 in BELIEVE, and so does the menu's clarify. Either the act's stage or its node in `wm-click-acts.edn` is wrong. The script flags this row.

㊢ (the audit, briefly)
- **EVALUATE:** none of 🈲 🈕 ㊫ has an act, and no click act sits at EVALUATE at all. R4, R5 and the two C_tau nodes are computed inside a step and never emitted as acts.
- **BELIEVE:** five of the six marks have no act (㊟ ㊣ 🈚 ㊮ 🈹). They are stances towards someone else's claim. The nearest thing the machine has is the reviewer's verdict, which the file tags as verify.
- **🈸 ask-action has no act.** The machine's one question to the operator, request-interpretation, is tagged clarify, which fits: it asks for an interpretation, not for an action.
- **Proposed intents for two of the untagged acts:** record-run-receipt → ㊢, like publish-selection-trace, which also writes TRACE; abstain → 🈝 defer, at the same stage. observe-world and refresh-preferences take things in rather than say anything, so `:none` looks right for them. I haven't edited the acts file.

🈸 (one decision) Shall I correct the R7 row and add the two proposed intents to `wm-click-acts.edn`? Its author would normally make that change, so I've left it untouched for now.

previous_reply_acts.text: (why R19 pairs with 象 rather than a mark) R19 reads a mission's preferences (C) from the mission's own text when the click runs. Every quote is pinned to its span, and a typed absence is recorded when nothing is stated. 象 does the same thing to your turns: fragments with spans, each with an intent reading. So in an operator → agent flow, R19 is the agent reading your turn. In this layer, two of the three operations are things an agent says (㊢, ㊩) and one is how it reads you. 🈖 explain may belong in BELIEVE as a belief update (R3), or at R2 as an interpretation, since your D3 ruling makes interpretations observations entering at R2. I haven't settled that.

previous_reply_acts.text:
(the WM side already does part of this) `futon2/holes/labs/wm-contract/wm-click-acts.edn` tags each WM click act with a stage, an R-node and a `:nearest-intent`:
- select-policy (R6) is already tagged `:prioritize`, i.e. ㊝.
- construct-cascade (R13) is already tagged `:propose`, i.e. ㊭.
- In the ACT layer, dispatch-author is R16, which fits 🈸 ask-action, and verify-review is R9, which fits ㊬ verify.
- observe-world (R2) has `:nearest-intent :none`. By the reading above, it should be `:report` (㊢).
